response.sql: WITH total_stats AS (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL) AS total_count, COUNT(DISTINCT city_id) AS num_cities FROM address), city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS count FROM address GROUP BY city_id) SELECT cc.city_id, cc.count AS address_count, cc.count / (ts.total_count / ts.num_cities) AS count_divided_by_avg, cc.count / ts.total_count AS share_of_all FROM city_counts cc CROSS JOIN total_stats ts ORDER BY share_of_all DESC LIMIT 10
